Notes

  • The default behavior only prunes expired tokens. cooling tokens stay untouched unless you explicitly enable deletion.
  • Auto-replenishment is based on the total number of active tokens across the managed pools.
  • New register tasks are created via the console API and push successful tokens back into the current Grok2API instance.
